---
name: A broker's page has changed
about: A manifest no longer matches the page it was written from
title: '[broker-id] '
labels: ''
assignees: ''
---

A manifest records what a page looked like on one day. Pages move. This is
the report for when one has.

**Which broker.** The `id` from the manifest filename, not the brand name as
it appears on the site.

**What the page shows now.** The field, button, or wording that no longer
matches. Quote the page's own words where you can: a label that changed from
one phrase to another is the useful thing, more than "the form is different".

**Which step.** If you know which step in the manifest fails, say so. If the
run stopped and told you, paste what it said.

**The date you looked.** Not the date you are writing. A page checked three
weeks ago is a different report from one checked this morning.

**Is a capture attached?** A screenshot of the current page settles it faster
than any description. If you attach one, it has to be clean the same way
every capture in this repository is clean: **no real person's name, address,
phone number, email address, date of birth, verification code, or one-time
link**, and no browser chrome showing your account. An empty form on a public
opt-out page usually holds none of that. If the page you need to show cannot
be made clean, describe it instead and say why there is no image.

**Anything you tried.** Especially other controls on the page. A broker whose
form is broken and a broker whose door has moved look identical from the
form, so "the button at the top does something different now" is worth more
than it sounds.
